# Component Reference

Every UIForge component is described by a machine-readable `ComponentSpec` manifest in the registry. These pages are generated from those manifests — the registry is the source of truth.

| Namespace | Components | Profile affinity |
|---|---|---|
| [Core Components](core.md) | `core.button`, `core.card`, `core.image`, `core.modal`, `core.tabs`, `core.text` | all profiles |
| [Analytics Components](analytics.md) | `analytics.bar-chart`, `analytics.filter`, `analytics.gauge`, `analytics.line-chart`, `analytics.metric`, `analytics.table` | dashboard, application, portal |
| [Application Components](application.md) | `application.action-bar`, `application.badge`, `application.checkbox`, `application.form`, `application.input`, `application.record-detail`, `application.record-list`, `application.select` | application, portal |
| [Assistant Components](assistant.md) | `assistant.composer`, `assistant.run-status`, `assistant.thread`, `assistant.thread-list`, `assistant.tool-call` | agent |
